model.name: R19.22.A: Every data/users/<u>/rooms/<r>/room.json is a symlink to scenario/index/<shard>/<r>.scenario.json + one-shot backfill.
model.description: Filesystem invariant: every room.json on disk is a symlink to the canonical Room scenario unit in the index. One-shot backfill converts existing standalone room.json files to symlinks pointing at the canonical scenario unit. After backfill, Room.persist writes to the canonical unit and the symlink resolves transparently.
model.refinementOfNote: Split from R19.22 per PO decision 2026-06-10: R19.22.A = filesystem invariant (symlink + backfill); R19.22.B = UI affordance (link to canonical unit).
